name: What is the process for a partial siding replacement project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a partial siding replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process begins with an initial inspection to assess the damage and determine the scope of work. Next, the contractor provides an estimate and a detailed plan. Once approved, existing damaged siding is carefully removed. Any underlying issues, such as water damage or rot, are addressed and repaired. New siding is then installed, cut to fit, and meticulously matched to the existing material in terms of color, texture, and profile. The final step involves clean-up and a final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes inspection, estimate, removal of damaged siding, underlying repairs, new siding installation, and final clean-up.
